cohort_notes.release_equivalent: EP4 exact selected row-address-prefetch implementation. Cleanup compared identical SASS+encodings for all4 fused kernels to its measured build.
cohort_notes.historical_transport_snapshot: EP8 previous complete bulk8 transport snapshot before row-address prefetch. Not remeasured latest release implementation; memory constrained. Never use both cohorts as one current-version geometric mean.
cohort_notes.small_token_external_reference_snapshot: Rows with M<192 restored from the external-reference matrix. They use frozen fusion configurations and the stronger max(CUTLASS, DeepGEMM) reference from that evidence; they are not a fresh latest-code remeasurement.

acceptance: User accepted current baseline. Original every-point >=15% gain and >=60% pure-GEMM retention targets NOT universally met.
